It is a pleasure to welcome the president and his delegation. Our two countries have a long history of cooperation, and that partnership has never been more important than it is today. We discussed a range of issues: security, trade, energy, and the support our nations are providing to those working for reform. I want to reaffirm that we stand firmly with the people of this country in their pursuit of sovereignty and territorial integrity; there should be no doubt about that. We also spoke about the practical steps we can take together, including assistance for economic recovery and support for the anti-corruption efforts that will make the reforms last. Mr. President, thank you for your leadership, and for your courage in difficult times.
